run_demo: run the VoxCPM2 speech generation Gradio demo server on a configurable port
create_demo_interface: create a Gradio interface for VoxCPM2 voice design, cloning, and speech generation
generate_tts_audio: generate TTS audio from text with optional voice cloning and control instructions
prompt_wav_recognition: transcribe reference audio to text using the SenseVoiceSmall ASR model
get_or_load_voxcpm: load the VoxCPM2 model from HuggingFace or a local path on demand
